crossRefs.note: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…

translations.web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
translations.bsb: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
translations.asv: Nevertheless, neither is the woman without the man, nor the man without the woman, in the Lord.
